fullPassage: But all this wisdom about how to deal with heat, accumulated over centuries of practical experience, is all too often ignored. The rise of air-conditioning accelerated the construction of sealed boxes, where the building’s only airflow is through the filtered ducts of the air-conditioning unit. It doesn’t have to be this way. Look at any old building in a hot climate, whether it’s in Sicily or Marrakesh or Tehran. Architects understood the importance of shade, airflow, light colors. They oriented buildings to capture cool breezes and block the worst heat of the afternoon. They built with thick walls and white roofs and transoms over doors to encourage airflow. Anyone who has ever spent a few minutes in a mudbrick house in Tucson, or walked on the narrow streets of old Seville, knows how well these construction methods work. In this sense, air-conditioning is not just a technology of personal comfort; it is also a technology of forgetting.

questions.passage: The rise of air-conditioning (A) the construction of sealed boxes. They oriented buildings to (B) cool breezes and block the worst heat. They built with thick walls and transoms over doors to (C) airflow.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: 에어컨의 등장이 밀폐 건물 건설을 가속화(accelerated)했고, 건축가들은 시원한 바람을 포착(capture)하고 공기 흐름을 촉진(encourage)했다.
det.analysis: ✅ ① accelerated — capture — encourage: 원문 일치
det.tip: accelerated(가속), capture(포착), encourage(촉진)

questions.passage: All this (A) about how to deal with heat, accumulated over centuries of practical experience, is all too often (B). In this sense, air-conditioning is not just a technology of personal comfort; it is also a technology of (C).
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: 열 관리에 대한 지혜(wisdom)가 무시(ignored)되고, 에어컨은 망각(forgetting)의 기술이다.
det.analysis: ✅ ① wisdom — ignored — forgetting: 원문 일치
det.tip: wisdom(지혜), ignored(무시), forgetting(망각)

questions.passage: All this wisdom about how to deal with heat is all too often ①<u>ignored</u>. The rise of air-conditioning ②<u>accelerated</u> the construction of sealed boxes. Architects understood the importance of ③<u>shade</u>, airflow, light colors. They oriented buildings to ④<u>release</u> cool breezes and ⑤<u>block</u> the worst heat.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~⑤ 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: 건물을 시원한 바람을 포착(capture)하도록 배치했다. ④ release(방출)는 capture의 반의어로 부적절.
det.analysis:
❌ ④ release(방출): 원문은 capture(포착)
✅ ⑤ block(차단하다): 원문 일치
det.tip: capture(포착) ↔ release(방출)

Air-conditioning is not just a technology of personal ③<u>comfort</u>; it is also a technology of ④<u>forgetting</u>. They built with thick walls and transoms over doors to ⑤<u>encourage</u> airflow.

❌ ② thin(얇은): 원문은 thick(두꺼운)

det.tip: thick(두꺼운) ↔ thin(얇은)
